title: Regional throttle slice: capacity data pull (GPU fleet) 2026-02-25
content_summary: Ad-hoc data extract to support a capacity incident postmortem for regional GPU saturation and request throttles. Purpose: pull a compact slice across telemetry, queueing, and throttle-events to validate hypotheses about autoscaler behavior, queue growth, and throttle code distribution for Feb 22Feb 25 2026. This sheet contains query text, column layout, representative sample rows, metric definitions, preliminary anomaly notes, and next steps for deeper forensic dives.
sheet_layout: region: cloud region code (e.g., us-west1, eu-central1)
active_pods: active serving pods on instance
queued_requests: requests waiting in local queue at sample time
avg_latency_ms: 1m average request duration at model route
throttle_code: internal throttle reason code (e.g., THROTTLE_CPU, THROTTLE_KV_OVERLOAD, THROTTLE_REGION_QPS)
throttle_count: number of throttle events observed in the minute
scale_action_delay_s: time between decision and GPU available (if any)
model_variant: model id and quantization tag
sql_queries:
-- primary slice: 1-min aggregation for suspect window
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', t.request_ts) AS timestamp_utc,
  t.region,
  i.cluster_id,
  i.instance_type AS instance_gpu_type,
  AVG(i.gpu_util) * 100 AS gpu_util_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.state='serving' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_pods,
  SUM(q.waiting_count) AS queued_requests,
  AVG(r.duration_ms) AS avg_latency_ms,
  SUM(th.count) AS throttle_count,
  ANY_VALUE(th.code) AS throttle_code
FROM telemetry.requests r
JOIN infra.instances i ON r.instance_id=i.id
LEFT JOIN telemetry.queues q ON q.instance_id=i.id AND time_bucket('1 minute', q.ts)=time_bucket('1 minute', r.request_ts)
LEFT JOIN infra.autoscaler_events s ON time_bucket('1 minute', s.ts)=time_bucket('1 minute', r.request_ts)
LEFT JOIN telemetry.throttle_events th ON time_bucket('1 minute', th.ts)=time_bucket('1 minute', r.request_ts)
WHERE r.request_ts BETWEEN '2026-02-22' AND '2026-02-25'
  AND r.region IN ('us-west1','eu-central1','ap-northeast1')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

-- throttle decode mapping sample (join to event metadata)
SELECT code, description, severity FROM infra.throttle_codes WHERE code IN (SELECT DISTINCT code FROM telemetry.throttle_events WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-02-22' AND '2026-02-25');

-- queue tail latency distribution per region/model_variant
SELECT time_bucket('5 minute', r.request_ts) AS ts5, r.region, r.model_variant, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.duration_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM telemetry.requests r
WHERE r.request_ts BETWEEN '2026-02-22' AND '2026-02-25'
GROUP BY 1,2,3;
metric_definitions: gpu_util_pct: average of per-GPU user/core utilization reported by driver telemetry multiplied by 100
queued_requests: sum of requests that are in the local instance queue (not yet scheduled to a pod)
throttle_count: number of infra-level throttle events logged for that minute and instance
cache_hit_rate_pct: combined prefix+KV cache hit metric used by the serving runtime
anomalies_highlights: Preliminary extract shows two distinct patterns: (1) short-lived extreme utilization spikes in us-west1 between 03:12-03:18 UTC on 2026-02-23 that coincide with a sudden drop in cache_hit_rate_pct and a surge in THROTTLE_KV_OVERLOAD; (2) longer tail queue growth in eu-central1 on 2026-02-24 where gpu_util stayed moderate (~65-75%) but queued_requests climbed steadily and autoscaler reported repeated no_action because scale signals were filtered by a cooldown misconfiguration. Both correlate with client-side burst workload (high priority background batch traffic) on certain model_variants.
pivot_recommendations: Pivot by region x model_variant to isolate which models cause KV overload vs CPU contention
Add a time series pivot of cache_hit_rate_pct alongside throttle_count to verify causal relation
Drill to instance-level (id) for top 10 throttle_count contributors and extract pod logs for those minutes
Compare autoscaler_event timestamps with cluster scaling logs to measure decision -> capacity latency
raw_data_sources: infra.instances (instance metadata, gpu type, cluster mapping)
telemetry.queues (per-instance queue depth by sample time)
calculation_notes: All aggregates use time_bucket('1 minute') to align sources. When joining throttle_events and queues, use LEFT JOIN and coalesce counts to 0. gpu_util_pct is driver_avg * 100; do not mix host-level CPU utilization aggregates with GPU driver metrics in the same column.
retention_note: This extract is temporary for the postmortem. Archive CSV to gs://redwood-infra-postmortem/ops-1248/ and delete query snapshots after 90 days unless requested otherwise.
